description: Scan a project's source code for AI tells, with no account and no AI. Returns the static AI tell index from 0 to 100, where lower is better, each tell found with its file and line, and the routes, forms and modals. start_review already runs it, so use it for a quick check outside a review.

dir.description: Folder to scan. A relative path starts from the folder the agent runs in. Defaults to that folder.

name: scan
